newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL CALL UP ASTON VILLA'S NELSON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL CALL UP ASTON VILLA'S NELSON.

text.p: Portugal have called up Aston Villa defender Fernando Nelson for their World Cup qualifier against Germany on Saturday in place of the injured Sergio Conceicao.
Conceicao, who plays for Portuguese champions Porto, had to pull out after injuring his left knee during training.
It was the second withdrawal suffered by Portugal, who lead European group nine. Defender Paulo Bento arrived from Spain's Oviedo nursing a leg injury but no replacement was summoned.
Portugal have seven points from four games, one more than Ukraine and three more than European champions Germany, who have played only twice.
